attributes.name: Daji
attributes.powers:
Display this card. While displayed, if you have the Witch trait gain the skills Arcane: Intelligence +2 and Craft: Intelligence +2.

While displayed, you may recharge a card to shuffle 1d4 random spells from your discard pile into your deck; if you have a role card, shuffle in 1d4+1 random spells instead. Then put this card on top of your deck.
